export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/isgec-heavy-engineering-limited), header: "Total Shipments 31322 Records detected", "Trading Partners 156", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact row seen: "2026-02-28 | ISGEC HEAVY ENGINEERING LIMITED | MOMBASA CEMENT LIMITED | ... MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Mombasa, Kenya | 84212190 | 1114350". Second row same date: "2026-02-28 | ISGEC HEAVY ENGINEERING LIMITED | TO THE ORDER OF SHINHAN BANK VIETNA | ... MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam | 84039000 | 1123596". Counter vs rows: page claims 31,322 shipments; only 5 individual shipment rows were rendered on the free view (2 export rows with B/L numbers 1114350 and 1123596, 1 import row from Ortlinghaus-Werke GmbH DE, 2 duplicate/related rows). Port breakdown shown: MUNDRA SEA 4166, MUNDRA SEA INMUN1 3903, Mombasa 2942, Surabaya 1203, Rayong 1177.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) and https://www.isgec.com/investors/annual-reports and /investor-relations/financial-results both returned HTTP 404. Only company-site claim available: isgec.com homepage states "Projects / Customers in 99 Countries across 6 Continents" and "Technologically advanced manufacturing facilities across 12 locations in India & Canada" — this is a self-declaration, not a verified domestic supply record. Domestic GST turnover: null (not public in retrieved sources).
note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records (Mundra Sea -> Mombasa, Kenya, HS 84212190, B/L 1114350, 2026-02-28; Mundra Sea -> Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, HS 84039000, B/L 1123596, 2026-02-28), plus recurring buyer lanes to Kenya, Indonesia (Surabaya), Thailand (Rayong) and a 4,145-shipment lane to Birla Carbon Thailand. Declared HS codes in the batch (732599; 840211; 840290; 841430) do not match the observed export HS codes (84212190, 84039000) — per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection; the company stays in the base and the actual HS codes should be recorded. Note the ImportKey page mixes import and export records under one company name (e.g. Ortlinghaus-Werke GmbH -> ISGEC, HS 84839000, B/L 7809239), so the 31,322 figure is a combined import+export counter, not export-only. Domestic supply: no verifiable GST/tender/contract record obtained within the tool budget — status declared_only, not confirmed. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in retrieved sources; not invented).
